rows.value: Sucia Island Floating Pumpout Station Installation

rows.label: What the project is
rows.value: Washington State Parks and Recreation Commission (State Parks) proposes to install a new offshore floating sewage pumpout station for recreational boaters at Fossil Bay at Sucia Island Marine State Park. This will include installation of two steel pipe pile and one aluminum floating pumpout barge station. The proposed pumpout facility was designed to minimize environmental impacts: it would be positioned in the subtidal zone (deeper than -10 feet MLLW) where submerged aquatic vegetation is less likely to be present, its planned location is in an area with no observed eelgrass (Grette Associates 2020), and it would require only two pile, which minimizes the square footage of substrate lost and results in less than one day of pile driving and associated noise impacts.
